title: Ideal-supported affine sections in powers of an ample pullback
statement: Let f:Y -> X be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], L an invertible module [def-sc-invertible-module], and M=f^*L its tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. Assume M invertible and ample [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module]. Let J be a quasi-coherent ideal sheaf on Y [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf] and y outside its support. There are n>0, a section v of J tensor f^*(L^n), and an affine open V containing y such that V is the nonvanishing locus of the image of v under J -> O_Y tensored with f^*(L^n), followed by the left unitor; V is disjoint from the support of J.

source.place: Lemma 09NX, final paragraph, construction t=t1*t2; Properties Proposition 01Q3 (1)/(6) and Lemma 01PV; monoidal pullback compatibility of Modules 01CD

proof.text: Use the compactness conjunct of IsAmple as the CompactSpace instance. Apply exists_section_of_ample_ideal to M=f^*L and J at y to obtain p>0, u, v, an equality identifying u with the ideal image of v, and y in the nonvanishing locus of u. The second conjunct of ampleness gives q>0, t and an affine open U containing y equal to the locus of t.

Apply affine_cap_section_open to the invertible module M^p, u, and U to get an affine open V with carrier U intersect the locus of u. Construct w by tensoring v with t, applying the associator, and then whiskering the inverse of tensorPowAddIso. The source tensor-section formulas, associator naturality, whisker exchange and left-unitor naturality identify its ideal image with tensor(u,t) transported through the inverse power-addition isomorphism.

Use mem_nonvanishingLocus_iff_generatesAt and the source exists_isFreeGenerator₂ to choose simultaneous local generators, and write u=a*e and t=b*d. The tensor-section formulas give product coefficient a*b. Scheme.basicOpen_mul and generatesAt_iff_mem_basicOpen give the intersection equality. The existing AmpleIso.nonvanishingLocus_iso theorem preserves nonvanishing under the power-addition isomorphism. Thus V is exactly the ideal-image locus of w and contains y.

At a point in J.support choose an affine local generator e of M^(p+q). The source bijective_tmulSection_right expresses the restriction of w as a tensor e. The image coefficient lies in J.ideal by range_toModulesι_app; mem_support_iff_of_mem and mem_zeroLocus_iff make this coefficient nonunit at that point. The basic-open criterion for generation contradicts nonvanishing. This proves disjointness without assuming J invertible.

Choose the pinned tensorPullback adjunction and compare it with the source pullbackPushforwardAdjunction by leftAdjointUniq. Compose this natural comparison, the proved source nonempty_pullback_tensorPow_iso and the existing AmpleIso.tensorPow_iso theorem applied to the comparison on L; invert to get M^(p+q) isomorphic to tensorPullback f (L^(p+q)). Tensor its hom with J and apply it to w. Whisker exchange and unitor naturality commute this with the ideal-image map. Preservation of nonvanishing under the isomorphism keeps V and its disjointness. Nat.add_pos_left gives p+q>0.
